rules.statement: There is no right of appeal to the Supreme Court from a decision of the District Judge under section 25 (2) of the Notaries Ordinance, refusing to issue the annual certificate to a Notary who had failed to apply for it within the time provided by the Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: No appeal lies to the Supreme Court from a decision of the District Judge under section 25 (2) of the Notaries Ordinance, refusing to issue the annual certificate to a Notary, who had failed to apply for it within the time provided by the Ordinance.

meta.parties: In the Matter of An Application of Albert Godamune, Proctor, Supreme Court, For the Annual Certificate To Practise As Notary
